1. Problem Statement

Patients may find it difficult to keep their health records organized and manage their
appointments. Doctors and nurses also need a clear way to view patient information and
follow their daily tasks. This project aims to develop MyHealth, an application that brings
these activities together. Patients can view their records, book appointments, and
download medical documents. Medical staff can manage visits, update records, and
follow tasks, while administrators can manage users and clinic activities. The project also
aims to provide an AI chatbot that analyzes uploaded PDF medical reports and explains
their main findings in simple words. This helps patients understand their reports, while
medical decisions remain with qualified healthcare professionals.




2. Project Objectives

Question1: How can one application help patients and medical staff manage health
records and appointments? Answer: Develop an application that allows patients to view
health records, book appointments, and download medical documents, while medical
<PARSED TEXT FOR PAGE: 2 / 3>
staff can manage visits and update patient records. Question2: How can an AI chatbot
help patients understand their PDF medical reports? Answer: Develop an AI chatbot that
analyzes uploaded PDF medical reports and explains their main findings in simple words.
Question3: How can the application help medical staff organize daily tasks and
administrators manage clinic activities? Answer: Develop staff pages to organize daily
tasks and administrator pages to manage users, appointments, and clinic activities.




3. Project Significance

MyHealth aims to make health information and clinic activities easier to manage. For
patients, it brings records, appointments, and medical documents into one place. The AI
chatbot can help explain medical reports in simple words. For doctors and nurses, the
app helps organize patient information and daily tasks. For clinics, it helps administrators
manage users, appointments, and staff activities. For society, the project could help
people better understand their health information and take a more active role in managing
their healthcare.




4. Brief Literature Review

Previous studies support the main ideas of MyHealth. Han et al. (2019) found that patient
portals can help people improve their health knowledge and manage their care. Zhao et
al. (2017) found that digital appointment systems can reduce waiting time and staff
workload, although results differ between clinics. Zaretsky et al. (2024) found that AI can
explain medical summaries in simpler language, but it may miss information or make
mistakes, so medical review is important. These findings support the idea of MyHealth,
which aims to bring health records, appointment booking, staff tools, and a chatbot for
explaining medical reports into one application.

7. Statement of Authenticity

Upon the submission of this document, we, the students of this project, declare that we
will submit an original work of our own for all the parts of the project and we will explicitly
acknowledge any work of others. In addition to that, we will ensure that the project to be
submitted had not been submitted for any other course.
